about_the_game:
Silent Forest is a narrative-driven game that blends multi-perspective storytelling with Roguelike card deckbuilding.

Set in Fantastia, a world where magic and industrial technology coexist, you will take on the roles of multiple protagonists. Each character brings their own unique abilities and perspectives, allowing you to uncover the secrets hidden deep within The Forest of Fantastia. Through original core mechanics, you will construct ever-changing decks and struggle to survive amid the conflicts of rival factions.

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

Welcome to The Forest of Fantastia, located on the frontier of the Mirroring Union.

After the collapse of a massive transnational alliance, the forest was left as a power vacuum—an enigmatic land few dare to approach. On this primal territory at the Edge of Civilization, conspiracies and schemes flourish. Power, magic, betrayal, and assassins clash across this lawless land.

The homeless who wander these woods, expedition groups drawn by profit, displaced people from competing factions, and hostile forest dwellers together form a fragile balance rooted in humanity’s most primal, beast-like instincts. Stripped of civilization’s veneer, the forest grants everyone their most fundamental freedom—while simultaneously concealing dangers beyond prediction.

Every choice you make has the potential to shatter this fragile balance and trigger an irreversible catastrophe.

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

Distinct Archetype Builds Across Multiple Characters

Here, you will no longer play as a single protagonist. Every expedition into the forest becomes a Rashomon-style experience of multi-perspective storytelling, where the same world is revealed through different eyes.

Each character choice offers a distinct deckbuilding approach and leads the story down a different path. Every decision matters, and the fate of the narrative rests firmly in your hands. With differentiated character-specific cards and storylines, each playthrough delivers an experience that is truly singular and endlessly unique.

Ann — A New Face in the Forest

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

A Unique Card System — Fusion(Combining the effects of two cards into one — what card game player wouldn’t love that?)

Breaking free from the constraints of traditional card games, this is where you can truly experience the joy of card fusion. Worried about not being able to draw two specific cards at the same time to pull off a combo? Or dreaming of merging two powerful cards into one? Now, all of this is possible in Silent Forest.

At the Fusion Bench in shops, you can pay a small price to obtain a brand-new card that combines the effects of two existing cards. These powerful Fusion Effects will accompany you throughout an entire run, becoming your most reliable allies.

There is no longer a single “strongest card” — only the strongest combinations. How to merge two card effects into a card that achieves 1 + 1 > 2 depends on your understanding of the current situation and the creativity you bring into each encounter.

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

The Commerce System(On the vast gray frontier at the edge of civilization, merchants always have their own ways of making money.)

Silent Forest is not only a strategic card game, but also an adventure centered on resource management and commercial strategy.

Supply systems on the fringes of civilization are never truly stable. Each settlement within the forest hosts a dynamic market, and skillfully exploiting price differences can allow you to create greater value. But remember: there is no such thing as a risk-free deal.

No one can predict the prices of the neighboring market, and no one knows whether tomorrow or disaster will arrive first in this wild land. All you can do is calculate profit and risk as precisely as possible, and leave the rest to fate.

To move toward the wilderness is the shared destiny of every saturated civilization. When humanity returns to nature, what choice will you make?

short_description: In this narrative-driven Roguelike deckbuilder, explore an unknown forest through multi-perspective storytelling. Build unique decks for each character and fight to survive amid clashes of magic, science, and rival factions at the Edge of Civilization.
